## Description of blocks

The workshop follows a guided path through selected sections of the Milan seminar notebooks. It moves from interpretation of Sobol indices to practical computation using Monte Carlo and polynomial chaos expansions (PCE), and concludes with application to representative cardiovascular models. The emphasis is on understanding trade-offs and identifying what drives uncertainty in practice.

---

## Outcome

Participants move from interpretation of Sobol indices to practical computation and application using both Monte Carlo and PCE approaches.
